json.title: Endless Golden Coast
json.logline: A nostalgic summer drive to the ocean captured in warm, sweeping gouache brushstrokes.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: A single felt piano note echoes over a quiet passenger seat view.
Warm analogue pad enters as the car accelerates along the coastline.
String swell peaks as blinding golden light fills the frame.
Wide arpeggio and sub bass burst into an expansive ocean vista.
Layered painted fragments drift into view with rhythm.
Final piano chord settles over the twilight sea skyline.

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the subject sitting in the vintage passenger seat
scenes.action: The young woman rests her chin on the passenger window frame.
scenes.setting: Inside a classic open-top car parked near a sunlit highway overlook

scenes.camera_note: Multi-plane parallax showing foreground coastal cliffs sliding past background ocean
scenes.action: The vintage convertible travels along the curved coastal cliff road.
scenes.setting: Winding coastal highway flanked by glowing golden-hour sea cliffs

scenes.camera_note: Tilt up from the speeding car door to the open sky and flowing hair
scenes.action: Ocean breeze sweeps through the young woman's wavy brown hair.
scenes.setting: Sunlit coastal road with tall grass bending in the seaside wind

scenes.camera_note: Rapid push in on profile lit by warm sun halation
scenes.action: The young woman smiles gently toward the blinding sun flare.
scenes.setting: Close-up passenger profile against warm amber evening light

scenes.camera_note: Wide sweeping pull out from the figure on the cliff to reveal an endless ocean horizon
scenes.action: The young woman stands on the high cliff edge extending her arms toward the vast ocean.
scenes.setting: Massive coastal cliff lookout overlooking endless shimmering golden sunset waves

scenes.camera_note: Drifting camera through floating gouache memory cards
scenes.action: Shimmering sea spray droplets float over warm painted road textures.
scenes.setting: Layered gouache montage of sea foam road signs and glowing waves

scenes.camera_note: Slow pull back as twilight deepens into cool blue shadows
scenes.action: The young woman sits on the car bonnet facing the quiet violet horizon.
scenes.setting: Quiet coastal lookout point at dusk with deep blue-violet twilight skies
